newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldovan industrial output falls 14.1 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Moldovan industrial output falls 14.1 pct in Sept.

text.p: Moldova's industrial output dropped 14.1 percent in September to stand 36.9 percent below September 1995's level, a report from the State Statistics Department said on Thursday.
Officials said the sharp fall in the tiny country's industry was due to this year's severe drought, which hit both the economy's leading agricultural sector and related processing industries.
MOLDOVAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT Sept '96 Aug '96 Sept '95
Industrial output dropped three percent in January-September of this year, compared to a 12.1 percent fall in the same period last year, the report said.
Agricultueal output fell by 17 percent in the first nine months of 1996, compared to an eight-percent fall in January- September last year.
The report provided no data for Moldova's gross domestic product in January-September.
